parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good morning, Sunshine Activity Holidays. Can I help you?
Hi! I'm ringing from Boston in the USA. We're coming to the UK in the summer to visit my parents and my children want to do an activity holiday at your centre.
Of course. First of all, may I take down some details? Can I have your children's full names, please?
My son is David, David William Smith, and my daughter is Maria Fiona with two "Ns", Smith.
And your home address?
463 Beacon Street, that's B-E-A-C-O-N Street, Boston, MA 02116.
Thanks, and a home phone number?
617-742-9835.
Our courses all start on a Saturday. Which week do your children want to come?
They need to do a course which begins on the 27th of June and finishes on the 4th of July.
So that's one week only. Okay, now have you got any particular activities in mind for them?
Well, last summer the whole family went sailing and they really enjoyed it, so I think it would be nice for them to do that again. You do that on a lake nearby I think.
That's right.
And my daughter would like to try surfing.
That’s a great choice. Would your son enjoy that too?
He’d rather do rock climbing. He completed a two-day program last year and he really enjoyed it.
I’ll make a note of that. Good. Any other sports they’d like to try?
The horse riding is number one on Maria’s list as she rides here in the United States. And David is keen to have lessons but he’s a bit nervous. I think he needs to build his confidence.
Okay, I’ve got that. I take it the children can swim. We’ve got two pools at the centre and we also take them to the beach.
Yes, they both swim well. In fact, I saw on your website that children can do their swimming awards during their stay.
Well actually we’re only offering the gold certificate this year. We didn’t get much interest in the silver and platinum awards last year.
I think David would like to do that. I don’t think Maria is ready yet.
That’s fine. What about indoor activities?
We offer quite a varied range.
Yes, I saw that David’s done a lot of drama so he’d like to do that. Maria is a bit shy but I think it would be good for her. Put her down for that too.
Well there are opportunities for everyone whether they’ve done it before or not so that’s fine. We’ll also be offering a new course which hasn’t been advertised yet: Cookery. That’s to replace woodwork.
Well Maria loves making cakes so she’d enjoy that and it’d be something different for David. Put them both down for that.
That’s fine. Well I’ll get a copy of their programme for the week sent to you as soon as possible.
Thank you. Oh by the way, will they need to bring any sports equipment with them?
We provide all safety equipment, riding hats, life jackets etc. free of charge. As well as things like surfboards and tennis rackets. But you can hire other equipment like a wetsuit for a small fee.
She does have her own but I don’t think there’ll be room in her luggage so we’d better hire one.
Fine.
Oh there’s just one other thing I need to check with you. My husband and I won’t be travelling to the UK with the children. We arrive a week later so they’ll need to be met at the airport. I would ask my parents to meet them but the flight gets in really early at 6.30 and they live a long way from the airport.
So we’ll need to book the transfer for seven o’clock. It’ll take them at least half an hour to get through immigration. We’ll have a representative waiting in arrivals. Now you’ll need to send us a deposit.

    ◦ (David and Maria)

analyses.content: 听到 home address 后，家长报出了门牌号 463 和街道名 Beacon（并进行了拼写），对应题干中 ....... Street 前的内容。
463 Beacon Street, that's B-E-A-C-O-N Street, Boston, MA 02116.
注意题干已经印在卷面上的 Street，所以你只需要填门牌号和街道名，不要重复写 Street。
They need to do a course which begins on the 27th of June and finishes on the 4th of July.
千万别填 4th of July，那是课程结束（finishes on）的日期。
题目问开始日期（Start date），录音明确说他们需要参加一个在 27th of June 开始的课程。
Well, last summer the whole family went sailing and they really enjoyed it, so I think it would be nice for them to do that again.
不要被后面的 surfing 或 rock climbing 干扰，那些是针对单个孩子的偏好，而不是两人都有经验的。
题目要求填两个孩子都有经验的运动（both have some experience），录音说全家人去年都去过 sailing 并且很喜欢，想再做一次。
And my daughter would like to try surfing. ... He’d rather do rock climbing.
不要填 rock climbing，那是儿子（David）想做的项目。
题目括号里注明了 Maria only，录音中妈妈明确说女儿（daughter）想尝试 surfing。
And David is keen to have lessons but he’s a bit nervous. I think he needs to build his confidence.
不要填 nervous，那是他现在的状态，不是他需要去发展（develop）的东西。
关于骑马，妈妈说 David 有点紧张，认为他需要建立他的 confidence（自信心），对应题干 develop his...。
Well actually we’re only offering the gold certificate this year. We didn’t get much interest in the silver and platinum awards last year.
不要填 silver 或 platinum，那是去年的项目，且录音说当时没什么人感兴趣。
录音提到今年只提供 gold（金牌）证书，并且 David 想考这个。
Yes, I saw that David’s done a lot of drama so he’d like to do that. Maria is a bit shy but I think it would be good for her. Put her down for that too.
进入室内活动，录音先提到 David 做过很多 drama，妈妈觉得这对 Maria 也有好处，所以把两人都记上了（Put her down for that too）。
We’ll also be offering a new course which hasn’t been advertised yet: Cookery. That’s to replace woodwork.
不要填 woodwork，录音明确说烹饪是用来 replace woodwork（取代木工）的。
录音提到一个新课程 Cookery（烹饪），妈妈说 Maria 爱做蛋糕，对 David 也是新尝试，于是把两人都报了名（Put them both down for that）。
But you can hire other equipment like a wetsuit for a small fee. ... so we’d better hire one.
不要填 safety equipment、surfboards 或 rackets，录音说这些都是免费提供的（free of charge）。
题目问需要租什么（Equipment to be hired），录音说你可以支付小额费用来租其他装备，比如 wetsuit（潜水服）。
I would ask my parents to meet them but the flight gets in really early at 6.30... So we’ll need to book the transfer for seven o’clock.
千万别填 6.30，那是航班降落（gets in）的时间，不是在到达大厅接到孩子的时间。
题目问几点接孩子，录音说虽然航班6:30到，但通关要半小时，所以需要预定 seven o’clock（7点）的接送。
